music: Existing theme low; lighten only at the Visitor's reactions; never a slapstick cue for imprisonment or assault.
mix: Near -14 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP. Effects below aligned narration.

new_assets.prompt: Quiet medieval lane by day: a few footsteps on packed earth, a wooden shutter somewhere, low distant voices without words. No carts, no market shouting.
Very quiet medieval lane at night: faint wind, a distant dog once, nothing else. No owls chorus, no crowd.
A plain wooden cupboard door closed firmly and latched once. No slam.
A wooden shop shutter swung closed and barred, modest and dry. No metal.
A single low church bell struck twice, slow, resonant, medieval-compatible; no electronic ping and no change-ringing peal.
Three slow footsteps on packed earth and stone, soft leather soles. No heel click.
A sheet of parchment turned once on a wooden table, dry rustle. No paper snap.
A plain wooden door closed and its latch dropped, quiet. No bolt or chain.
